credentials.description: Bedrock API key used as a bearer token. Takes precedence over SigV4 credentials, including a `credentialProvider`.
Access key for SigV4 signing when no bearer token or credential provider is configured.
Secret key for SigV4 signing when no bearer token or credential provider is configured.
Optional session token for temporary credentials. Not read when both access keys are set in settings.
AWS region. Defaults to `us-east-1` when neither this, `AWS_DEFAULT_REGION` nor `region` is set.
Fallback region, read when `AWS_REGION` is not set.
Optional endpoint override for Converse, embedding and image requests.
Optional endpoint override for reranking requests.
Optional endpoint override for all Bedrock services when no service-specific URL is set.

notes: Foundation models on Amazon Bedrock through the Converse API, plus Titan, Cohere and Nova embeddings, Nova Canvas images and Bedrock reranking. Authenticate with a Bedrock API key or AWS SigV4 credentials; the AWS SDK credential chain is not used, so supply credentials through settings, a credential provider closure or environment variables.

notes: Claude models on Amazon Bedrock called through InvokeModel in Anthropic's native Messages format, so Anthropic provider options and tool definitions carry over. It shares settings and authentication with the Amazon Bedrock provider.

Access key for SigV4 signing when no bearer token or credential provider is configured.

notes: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and Responses endpoints on Amazon Bedrock Mantle, authenticated with a Bedrock API key or SigV4 credentials. The endpoint path is chosen from the model ID.
